resourceScope: reachable owned primitive array payload and bounded GC observation; not full retained heap
eventPump: actual SDK one-event context-reset dispatch; 100us requested idle park; cumulative actual cadence retained, no staging readers
scope: actual SDK direct source+calculator excludes factory/document lease lifecycle; execution actual request-to-observed markup; headless ACTIVE, no real focus/paint

synchronousRequestEntry.scope: actual synchronous handle.request on EDT; excludes handle construction and subsequent async work

unchangedPresentationCallback.scope: synchronous unchanged-presentation UI callbacks; baseline may return early, no forced internal render

allocation.allocationOverhead: includes trace and read-observer bookkeeping; not exclusively production allocation
